_comment: Factions of the slice (GDD 12; owner 2026-10-12: one or two local ones while the game stays in the Grey Chapels). Reputation -100..100; tier effects: infirmary_mult (the Ash Sisters' prices: treatment and calming the blood), extra_signs (known signs on new leaflets), reward_mult (rewards of new leaflets). A finished contract raises its petitioner's faction and lowers its rivals'.

factions.name: The Grey Communion
factions.text: The chapels' old congregation and its Ash Sisters. They want the creatures understood, and preferably alive.

factions.name: The Iron Vigil
factions.text: The order's night watch in the Grey Chapels. They keep dossiers on every creature and want them dead.
